result.quote: the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him.
result.reason: The action is supported, but the window says the old prophet saddled “the donkey for him,” not that it was the man’s donkey; ownership is unsupported. Also, “after eating” naturally suggests that the old prophet ate, whereas the passage says the man of God had finished eating. A clearer question would be: “What did the old prophet do after the man of God finished eating and drinking?” The supported answer is: “He saddled the donkey for him.”
